note: Both extractions bind the Table 6-1 values to the correct rows, and neither contains a misread or invented number. Set A consistently translates the columns into plain property names (fore-aft/side-to-side stiffness and inertia, axial stiffness, torsional stiffness, mass density, cg offsets) and its quotes carry the column headers plus row coordinates that actually support each claim. Set B instead leaves raw column labels (TwSScgOf, TwEAStif, TwFAIner, TwGJStif) and spends four claims on trivial row coordinates (elevation 52.56/61.32 m, HtFract 0.8/0.9) that are conditions rather than tower properties, with bare-number quotes that give no context. Set A is thus the more faithful and informative extraction, though its few naming slips ("TwEAStif", "forward-aft") are minor.
